primary_goal: Drive users to search, browse listings by category/location, or publish a new listing.

friction_points.issue: A large third-party banner ad dominates the upper viewport, displacing core platform search and discovery elements.
friction_points.evidence: The 'TOYOTA BLACK WEEKS' banner takes up roughly 40% of the initial mobile fold directly under the search bar.

friction_points.issue: The primary seller action ('Anzeige aufgeben') lacks visual prominence and is buried as plain text in the page footer.
friction_points.evidence: In the footer section, 'Anzeige aufgeben' is formatted as a standard grey text link alongside legal links.

friction_points.issue: Extremely long vertical list of top cities creates excessive page height and user scroll fatigue on mobile.
friction_points.evidence: 'Top Orte' lists 16 city names (Berlin through Stuttgart) vertically across screens 2 and 3.

friction_points.issue: Single-column category menu requires deep vertical scrolling to scan all 14+ categories.
friction_points.evidence: Categories from 'Alle Kategorien' down to 'Nachbarschaftshilfe' are displayed in a long single-column stacked list.

friction_points.issue: Legal and trust links (Impressum, Datenschutz, Widerruf) in the footer are tightly packed and hard to tap on mobile touchscreens.
friction_points.evidence: Footer text links like 'Vertrag Widerrufen', 'Impressum', 'Datenschutz' are tightly wrapped across multiple lines with minimal spacing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the long single-column list of cities ('Top Orte') with a 2-column grid or collapsible accordion menu, then engagement with location filters will increase because users reach relevant options with less scrolling.
hypotheses.change: Reformat 'Top Orte' into a compact 2-column grid or interactive location pills.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we introduce a sticky bottom action bar with a prominent 'Anzeige aufgeben' button, then listing creation starts will increase because the main revenue/supply driver is always visible.
hypotheses.change: Add a floating/sticky 'Anzeige aufgeben' CTA button at the bottom of the mobile screen.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we convert the main category list into a 2-column icon grid, then category click-through rates will improve because users can digest options faster above the fold.
hypotheses.change: Layout top categories in a 2-column icon grid format instead of single-column row items.

quick_wins: Format 'Top Orte' into a multi-column layout to drastically reduce page height.
Style 'Anzeige aufgeben' in the footer as a highlighted button or move it to the header navigation.
Increase padding and tap target sizes for footer legal links (Impressum, Datenschutz).
uncertainties: Ad revenue reliance vs. organic user conversion loss from the top banner placement.
Percentage of mobile traffic coming via native app vs. mobile browser.
Ratio of buyers vs. sellers landing on the homepage.
